_comment: Copy this to config.json and put it beside BWLadderReview.exe. Every field is optional except playerNames - everything else is autodetected, and only needs setting if the autodetect gets it wrong.
_starcraftInstallPath: Autodetected from the registry, then from the usual install folders. Set it if the app reports it could not find StarCraft.
_lastReplayPath: Autodetected under Documents\StarCraft\Maps\Replays. Set it if your replays live elsewhere (a OneDrive-redirected Documents folder, or another drive).
_port: The port the overlay is served on. Change it only if something else already uses 3712.
